enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Legendary Accuracy +5: Passive: +5 Legendary bonus to attack rolls
Slashing 7: The edges of this weapon are sharpened, dealing an additional 7d6 slashing damage on each hit.
Gashing 16: The edges of this weapon are sharpened beyond belief, dealing an additional 16d6 slashing damage on each critical hit.
Dripping with Magma: This Obsidian weapon drips with magma on every swing. Your attacks have a high chance to deal very strong fire damage over time.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
